scriptLines: admission_date = coalesce(   toDate(trim(admission_date), 'yyyy-MM-dd'),   toDate(trim(admission_date), 'MM/dd/yyyy'),   toDate(trim(admission_date), 'MM-dd-yy'),   toDate(trim(admission_date), 'dd-MMM-yyyy'),   toDate(trim(admission_date), 'MMMM dd, yyyy') ),

discharge_date = coalesce(   toDate(trim(discharge_date), 'yyyy-MM-dd'),   toDate(trim(discharge_date), 'MM/dd/yyyy'),   toDate(trim(discharge_date), 'MM-dd-yy'),   toDate(trim(discharge_date), 'dd-MMM-yyyy'),   toDate(trim(discharge_date), 'MMMM dd, yyyy') ),

department = case(   instr(upper(trim(department)), 'ONCO') > 0, 'Oncology',   instr(upper(trim(department)), 'CARDIO') > 0, 'Cardiology',   instr(upper(trim(department)), 'EMERG') > 0 || upper(trim(department)) == 'ER', 'Emergency',   instr(upper(trim(department)), 'PED') > 0 || instr(upper(trim(department)), 'PAED') > 0, 'Pediatrics',   instr(upper(trim(department)), 'ORTHO') > 0, 'Orthopedics',   instr(upper(trim(department)), 'SURG') > 0, 'General Surgery',   instr(upper(trim(department)), 'NEURO') > 0 || instr(upper(trim(department)), 'NUERO') > 0, 'Neurology',   'General' ),
derivedColumn1 derive(admission_date = iif(   isNull(admission_date),   discharge_date,   iif(!isNull(discharge_date) && discharge_date < admission_date, discharge_date, admission_date) ),
discharge_date = iif(   !isNull(discharge_date) && !isNull(admission_date) && discharge_date < admission_date,   admission_date,   discharge_date )) ~> derivedColumn2
